Timeline::isnat_scalar¶

Back to Timeline API Reference

Signature¶

Timeline::isnat_scalar() -> bool

What It Does¶

Returns whether a scalar Timeline holds NaT.

This is the scalar-only companion to isnat:

  • isnat() Returns a boolean Series for array-shaped timelines.

  • isnat_scalar() Returns one bool for a 0D timeline.

Returns¶

bool true when the scalar instant is absent, otherwise false.

Examples¶

Example 1. A defined scalar Timeline holds an instant.

auto flag = scalar.isnat_scalar();
std::cout << (flag ? "true" : "false") << "\n";

Output¶

false

Example 2. The documented absent-instant path reports true.

auto flag = scalar_nat.isnat_scalar();
std::cout << (flag ? "true" : "false") << "\n";

Output¶

true

Notes¶

  • This method expects a scalar timeline. It is not the right surface for 1D, 2D, or 3D temporal payloads.

  • The current text-input path for a scalar absent instant is the empty string, not the literal text "NaT".
